mcqs.keyword: First F1-approved national sim racing competition
mcqs.question: The F1 Sim Racing India Open 2026 is notable as which of the following?
options: India’s first official Formula 1 Sim Racing Championship and first F1-approved national sim racing competition
India’s first Formula 1 Grand Prix held at Buddh International Circuit
India’s first FIA-governed professional motorsport championship
India’s first Commonwealth Chess Association championship
mcqs.explanation: The F1 Sim Racing India Open 2026 is India’s first official Formula 1 Sim Racing Championship and first F1-approved national sim racing competition. The Buddh International Circuit hosted the Indian Grand Prix from 2011 to 2013, but that was not a sim racing championship.
